body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose two allies within 5 units. Each may move 1 unit; if they end adjacent, both gain +1 Defense until your next turn.

surges.html: One affected ally gains +1 Defense against the next Action that targets it.
Remove Dazed, Concussed, or Shocked from one affected ally.

rider.title: FORMATION — AUTHORITY
rider.html: Spend this card's Authority when an ally enters or leaves adjacency with another ally: 1–3 move one of them 1 unit; 4–5 both may move 1 unit; 6+ both may move 1 unit and one becomes Rallied.
rider.meta: STORE ONE ROLLED RESULT; THAT RESULT IS REMOVED FROM THIS ACTION
